items.text: To effectively help our communities battle the #opioidcrisis, Congress needs to pass bipartisan legislation that includes prevention and education efforts, promotes treatment, cracks down on illegal distribution, and enhances resources for first responders and law enforcement.

Great to be on @aanacrna’s Moving the Needle podcast this AM to talk about the role #nurses play in providing high quality care to patients and how removing barriers preventing #CRNAs from practicing will help address workforce shortages in health care systems across the U.S. https://t.co/AZqeXPcmPB

I cannot support a bill that doesn't take into account, aside from the physician prescribed treatment of a minor, that #cannabis is and should remain an adult product with federal safety and production regulations.

Senators @SenSchumer @RonWyden @SenBooker also recognize this.

For the sake of patients across the country, as well as USA's medical superiority across the globe, we can't allow outdated federal policy to keep obstructing legitimate medical research.

Proud to cosponsor/vote for @repblumenauer @RepAndyHarrisMD Medical Marijuana Research Act. https://t.co/0MPoiwRk0y

Proud to join my friend and colleague @RepGarbarino in this important effort.

We must ensure the men and women who responded to and survived the terrorist attacks of 9/11 continue to have the health care coverage they deserve.

We cannot allow the men and women who put their lives on the line that fateful day to lose the health coverage they need to treat the illnesses that they sustained from responding to the 9/11 terrorist attacks. Read our full letter below ⤵️ https://t.co/BrqZ9toYFd

Last week I was proud to vote for the Improving Seniors’ Timely Access to Care Act, which streamlines Medicare Advantage's prior authorization procedures. By prioritizing patients over paperwork we can help move our healthcare sector into the 21st century. https://t.co/JMahJUY6FK

#DYK that universities receive special tax treatment? Donations to their endowments are not taxed and their assets get to grow effectively tax free.

That shouldn't be the case if they're increasing their tuition costs higher than the rate of inflation.

Starting off the full committee markups for FY24 this morning with the Military Construction-Veterans Affairs appropriations bill. Fully funding veterans’ programs, benefits, & healthcare are just a few of the provisions my @HouseAppropsGOP colleagues and I included in the bill. https://t.co/rLKglXh26h

This morning, I attended @RiponSociety’s breakfast where I had the opportunity to discuss the priorities of the Addiction, Treatment and Recovery Caucus. 

As Co-Chair of the Caucus, it was important to hear more about the mental health challenges in our country. https://t.co/VRvJQnOvhC

The @ClevelandClinic officially opened in Mentor, OH, making it one of the first hospitals in the country to be built with private 5G. With high resolution cameras, check-in kiosks, and high-tech imagining, I am proud to see this technological innovation right here in OH-14.

Proud to see the Cleveland Clinic has been named one of America’s top hospitals and ranked #1 for cardiology in the U.S. 

Thank you to all the health care professionals who provide this world renown care. 

https://t.co/QRQNJi8G82
As Co-Chair of the Addiction Treatment and Recovery Task Force, I am constantly working with my colleagues to find bipartisan solutions to end the opioid epidemic once and for all.

Today, as #CongressGoesPurple, we raise awareness about the addiction epidemic in our country & celebrate Americans in recovery. I proudly serve as Co-Chair of the Addiction, Treatment, and Recovery Caucus which is committed to advancing solutions to the addiction crisis. https://t.co/4BthfX3H1t

In fact, the Department of Defense conducted a study that found that Virtual Hope Box can decrease feelings of stress and anxiety in individuals experiencing symptoms of depression. If this app can prevent one loss of life, that is worth it to me.

As Co-Chair of the Addiction, Treatment, and Recovery Caucus, I am diligently working with my colleagues on both sides of the aisle to put a stop to this crisis by facilitating important conversations and making impactful policy changes.

As National Certified Registered Nurse Anesthetists (CRNAs) week comes to a close, we must continue to recognize the heroic and transformative care CRNAs contribute to the healthcare field. 

Their unique expertise plays a vital role in keeping our communities healthy. https://t.co/ZZeMxfAbeZ

Proud to announce over $500K for Kent State University funded by @NSF through the FY24 Appropriations package that I supported.

This critical funding will advance research to improve our nation’s medication distribution and healthcare system as a whole. https://t.co/NzlSO9gJr8

As the proud husband of a nurse, I’ve seen the dedication and compassion nurses provide for their patients firsthand.

Today, I joined my Nursing Caucus colleagues in introducing a resolution celebrating National Nurses Week to thank these health care heroes for all they do. https://t.co/o0bC5SM1oS

Today, we began the House Appropriations FY25 markups with the Military Construction-Veterans Affairs Subcommittee. 

In the bill, I fought to fund veterans’ healthcare, the VA, and benefit programs. Those who fought for our country deserve the best care when they return home. https://t.co/sA1Zo8Xl2z

In Congress, we must continue to increase rail safety and help the area rebuild.

Today, I introduced the East Palestine Health Impact Monitoring Act to conduct proper research through HHS to identify any long-term health impacts from the tragedy now and in the future.

Starting off today’s markups with the FY25 Labor, Health and Human Services, and Education appropriations bill.

This bill contains critical funding to prevent substance abuse, ensure school safety, and fight the ongoing opioid epidemic in our country. https://t.co/F622wlmSFs

I am saddened to hear of the passing of Congresswoman Sheila Jackson Lee whose life was taken too soon by the same deadly cancer that took the life of my predecessor. 

Kelly and I are praying for her loved ones at this time.

https://t.co/Bo0Hn4J6jB
If you’re at the Ohio State Fair today, make sure to stop by one of the many mental health resource booths!

Disappointed to hear that Trumbull Regional Medical Center & Hillside Rehabilitation Hospital is closing. Moving forward, I will work with local officials and healthcare providers to help ensure residents have access to the care they deserve.
